description: This PHP source file defines the PackageManagerDownloader class, which provides functionality to download files from a specified server using cURL. It includes constant definitions for server URLs and a static method to perform the download, handling optional directory and server URL parameters.

classes.name: PackageManagerDownloader
classes.description: A class responsible for downloading files from the depot server using cURL.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a file from the depot server using cURL, with optional parameters for save directory and server URL.
